name: competition-start

description.en: Start the next unused Booga Town competition by name.
description.de: Startet den nächsten unbenutzten Booga-Town-Wettbewerb nach Namen.
description.es: Inicia la siguiente competición no usada de Booga Town por nombre.
description.fr: Démarre le prochain concours Booga Town inutilisé par nom.
description.it: Avvia la prossima competizione Booga Town non usata per nome.
description.ro: Începe următoarea competiție Booga Town nefolosită după nume.

bot: Use when a user starts a competition, e.g. '/compete test'.

inputs.name: Name

description.es: Nombre de la competición (p. ej. test)

inputs.bot: The competition name the user asked for.

inputs.name: found
inputs.modifier: transform:() => { const name='{{name}}'.trim().toLowerCase(); const raw='{{state.competition}}'; const d=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{bank:[],active:null}; return d.bank.some(q=>q.name===name && !q.used); }

inputs.name: dataJson
inputs.modifier: transform:() => { const name='{{name}}'.trim().toLowerCase(); const raw='{{state.competition}}'; const d=raw?JSON.parse(raw):{bank:[],active:null}; const item=d.bank.find(q=>q.name===name && !q.used); if(!item) return JSON.stringify(d); item.used=true; d.active={name:item.name,question:item.question,answer:item.answer}; return JSON.stringify(d); }

inputs.name: message
